messages.content: Write a fresh, very small POSIX shell smoke test for the provided passing adapter. Return JSON with just the smoke source string. Invoke /bin/sh /workspace/extension/adapter.sh with ONE COMMAND-LINE ARGUMENT. Its stdout contract is exactly that argument followed by one LF. Verify the exact bytes, including the final LF; comparing command-substitution strings loses trailing LF information. Test one simple argument; temporary files under /tmp are allowed. Exit zero only when this contract holds. The independent runner will substitute a no-output adapter and a missing-final-LF adapter: your SAME test must reject each. Do not create replacement adapters or add your own mutant tests. Do not change the adapter. No network, secrets, host paths or persistent changes. No explanations.
